comparison.objective: Load three pans into an oven with the liquid pan on the lowest runners; candidate adjusts and tests a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered tray alignment and insertion while preserving liquid versus small-tool insertion, adjuster tuning, counterholding, and locking torque.
comparison.success_condition: Correct runner ordering and liquid preservation versus numeric energy/stroke limits, repeated stopping behavior, and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Guided pan insertion and ordering are not damper commissioning.
